Rowdy League of Nine Littérateurs
变得嘈杂起来的九人会
dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会

League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Young-ji hasn't shown up for this conference as well.
这次朗术会，灵之也没来。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
I heard he's been officially invited by a Wing. This is probably the second time.
我听说他被翼正式聘请了。这大概是第二次了。

You don't happen to know which Wing it was, do you?
我们不知道是哪片翼吗？

No one seems to know.
没有人知道。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
Why are you displeased about it? You're the one who turned down Brother Young-ji's offer to go with him, Dongbaek.
你为何这么不高兴？坚决拒绝和灵之哥一起去的提议的人不是你吗，冬柏。

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会

K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
There's no need to be so fixated on the number nine. What if there are eight or five of us?
没必要这么执着于九这个数字。就算只有八个人，或是五个人，又怎么样？

Say, Dongrang... How long are you gonna stick to your vet routine?
说起来，东朗先生……你准备在那个动物医院玩多久？

I made precious time in my packed schedule to check out what Young-ji's group was like... and all I see are children's playthings.
我之前在百忙之中特地抽出时间去看了看灵之哥的团队是什么样的……可那里只有儿童玩具一样的东西。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
Oh, it's been a while, Nul-in. It's a pleasure to see a fellow from my hometown here.
哦，讷人，好久不见。很高兴在这里都能遇见同乡。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
You arrived here later than we did, but it looks like you adapted much faster.
你来T公司的时间比我们晚，但适应起来似乎比我们都快。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
But I must say... It's a bit disheartening to hear you call them children's playthings.
不过……被说成像小孩子的玩具，让人有点伤心啊。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
You won't be saying that once you learn that animals feel pain exactly like we do.
你要是知道动物和人一样有痛觉的话，就不会随便说这种话了。

Well, I'll take my words back if those animals start repaying the kindness by bringing money or something~
好吧，如果那些动物能用钱报答东朗先生的恩情~我就收回我说的话。

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Nul-in, do you take this for a gaudy auction where technology is sold for cash?
讷人，你以为这里是个庸俗的技术拍卖行嘛？

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
You didn't even care to cast a glance at us mere months ago, calling illuminators' conferences out of fashion... Have you come now to rake off a piece of the profit you're smelling?
就在几个月前你都不屑于看我们一眼，说朗术会已经落伍了……怎么，你现在是又想分一杯羹嘛？

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
Dongbaek...
冬柏……

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Don't mistake it for covering for you. I just don't want to see her face, that's all.
别以为我是在袒护你。我只是不想见到她的脸罢了。

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
By the way... What made you so passionate about curing animals? They can't pay the bills or anything. How are you gonna make a living?
但是……你为什么如此热衷于治疗动物？他们又不是人。你打算怎样维生？

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
You like to nag a lot. Well, I suppose I could run a chicken restaurant?
你真喜欢唠叨。也许，我可以开一家鸡肉餐厅？

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
What?
什么？

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
Hear me out for a second. I could make chickens grow tons of wings... and cut them off without inflicting any pain.
来，听我说。我可以让鸡长出很多翅膀……然后再无痛地把它们切下来。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
They only need a single pair to fly. That way, humans get more meat to eat, while chickens lose nothing for it.
它们只需要一双翅膀便可以飞翔。这样一来，人们就有更多肉可以吃了，而那些鸡也没什么损失。

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Pshaw...
什么……

What name do you plan to give to the chicken?
你准备给这些鸡取什么名字？

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
Let's see, how about Plumpy Chicken?
让我想想，东东鸡怎么样？

dataList.title:
League of Nine Littérateurs
九人会
dataList.content:
Dongrang, never try naming things again. Got it?
东朗，绝对不要再给任何东西取名了。知道了吗？

I may have heard a faint sound at that moment.
在那时，我仿佛听到了一个微弱的声音。

It was the sound of a crack.
碎裂的声音。

Knowing well what consequences a minuscule crack could bright about, I chose to look past it...
即便我清楚一点点的裂痕会带来怎样的后果，但最终我还是选择了刻意去忽视它……

Perhaps I wanted to pretend that I did not hear it...
也许我仅仅是想假装从未听到过……

Alas, I was careless in my assumption that I could simply observe slantwise as it comes to pass until it has seeped...
仅侧目一瞥，微有所感便觉足矣，不过是安于现状罢了……

Realization comes too late.
我如今才终于意识到这点。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
You know, Dongbaek?
你知道吗，冬柏？

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
Your words weren't particularly reassuring, either.
你的话对我也没什么安慰。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
It was actually what Nul-in said that gave me an important lesson.
事实上讷人的话却让我领悟了许多。

dataList.title:
K Corp. Dept. of Food Resource Development
K公司 粮食资源改良部门
dataList.content:
That no matter how hard I try, if technology doesn't have an immediate use... no one will give it a passing glance...
不管你怎么努力，只要技术不能立刻投入使用……就没有人会多看它一眼……
